metadata.description: A template for creating an epic fantasy novel in the style of Brandon Sanderson or Patrick Rothfuss

bookVision.title: The Chronicles of [Your World Name]
bookVision.concept:
In a world where magic is systematized and controlled by ancient academies, a young orphan discovers they possess a forbidden form of magic that hasn't been seen in centuries. As dark forces gather on the borders of the known world, our protagonist must master their powers while unraveling a conspiracy that threatens the very fabric of reality.

KEY ELEMENTS:
- Hard magic system with clear rules and limitations
- Political intrigue within magical academies
- Found family dynamic among diverse cast
- Ancient prophecy with modern twist
- Themes of power, responsibility, and identity
- Multiple POV characters
- Epic scope with intimate character moments
bookVision.worldContext:
WORLD BUILDING:

MAGIC SYSTEM:
- Magic is drawn from natural elements (earth, fire, water, air, lightning, light, shadow)
- Requires both innate talent and rigorous training
- Each mage can typically master 1-2 elements in their lifetime
- Magic has a cost - physical exhaustion, emotional toll, or resource depletion
- Forbidden magic: Time manipulation, mind control, reality warping

POLITICAL STRUCTURE:
- Five major kingdoms, each with their own magical academy
- Council of Archmages oversees magical education and enforcement
- Tension between traditional nobility and emerging magical meritocracy
- Border conflicts and resource disputes

HISTORY:
- 1000 years since the Great Cataclysm that nearly destroyed magic
- Ancient civilization left behind mysterious artifacts and ruins
- Cyclical pattern of magical renaissance and decline

CHARACTERS:

PROTAGONIST:
- Age: 16-18
- Background: Orphaned, raised in a remote village
- Discovery: Can wield multiple elements simultaneously (forbidden)
- Arc: From naive outsider to reluctant hero to confident leader
- Flaws: Impulsive, stubborn, trusts too easily
- Strengths: Compassionate, quick learner, natural leader

MENTOR:
- Exiled former Archmage with dark past
- Haunted by failure that led to student deaths
- Reluctant to train protagonist
- Knows more about the prophecy than they reveal

ANTAGONIST:
- Believes they're saving the world through extreme measures
- Sympathetic motivations rooted in past trauma
- Commands forbidden magic
- Revealed to have connection to protagonist

SUPPORTING CAST:
- Rival-turned-ally from noble family
- Book-smart scholar with social anxiety
- Gruff warrior with secret gentle side
- Enigmatic merchant with hidden agenda
bookVision.writingStyle:
STYLE GUIDELINES:

PROSE:
- Clear, accessible prose with moments of lyrical beauty
- Active voice and vivid sensory details
- Balance action, dialogue, and introspection
- Show character emotions through action and dialogue, not just telling

PACING:
- Action chapter followed by character development chapter
- Build tension gradually with explosive payoffs
- End chapters on hooks or revelations
- Vary chapter length for dramatic effect

DIALOGUE:
- Natural, character-specific speech patterns
- Avoid excessive exposition in dialogue
- Use subtext and conflict in conversations
- Modern sensibility without modern slang

MAGIC DESCRIPTION:
- Concrete, sensory details of spell casting
- Clear cause and effect
- Show the cost of magic use
- Make magic feel wondrous yet scientific

TONE:
- Generally hopeful despite dark moments
- Earnest without being naive
- Epic scope grounded in human emotion
- Serious stakes with moments of levity

hints: Establish your magic system's rules clearly in Chapter 1-2
Introduce your protagonist's ordinary world before the inciting incident
Create a diverse cast with distinct voices and motivations
Build your world through character interactions, not info dumps
Plant seeds for later revelations from the beginning
Give your antagonist understandable (if not justifiable) motivations
Use multiple POV characters to show different perspectives
Balance epic set pieces with intimate character moments
End act one with a major revelation or point of no return
Ensure each supporting character has their own arc
